about.title: About
about.description: The story, ritual, and collection of Lamsa.
about.heading: About Lamsa
about.intro: Lamsa is a skincare and fragrance house. The name means a touch, and the work starts there: formulas you can feel, a gold floral mark, and a routine quiet enough for every day.
about.gentleBody: Creams and oils are made to be warmed in the hands before they meet the skin.
about.routineBody: Cleanser, mist, serum, facial oil, and moisture cream. Each has a place in the morning or the evening.
about.beautyBody: Soft florals, warm gold, and a light finish. The same feeling runs through the fragrance and the care.
about.collectionBody: Radiant Glow Cleanser, Hydrating Essence Mist, Brightening Facial Oil, Renewing Moisture Cream, and Hyaluronic Acid Serum. Every bottle carries the Lamsa mark, and every formula is meant to be used, not only displayed.
about.ritualAlt: Hands holding an open Lamsa cream jar, with dropper bottles and flowers on marble
about.lineAlt: The Lamsa skincare line: cleanser, essence mist, facial oil, moisture cream, and hyaluronic serum
